why: Lint cycle 2 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-2.md): the class `wiring` P2s and P3. A `.stylelintignore` naming a subdirectory of a declared root silences the stylesheet guard there and doctor reports no weakened guard (weaken W16, lint-2.24); `.oxlintignore` does not weaken oxlint, because `basalt-ui lint` passes no ignore file, but stylelint reads its own. check-theme survived v3-teardown-runtime: the verb and `src/guard/**` still ship, the repo's `pre:static` still runs it over the playground, it tells a v3 app 'no .oxlintrc.json up to the repo root extends basalt-ui/configs/oxlint.json', pointing it at the 2.x config, and it reports `raw-hex` on an Issue reference (`ref: '#657'`, dogfood-1.19) (lint-2.26). Cycle 1 left its check-theme finding (lint-1.25) unfiled because the teardown would delete the verb; v3-teardown-peers' owns does not name it. The editor hook's pre-edit denies a managed id set by hand but lets `ignorePatterns`, a blanket `/* oxlint-disable */` and a `.stylelintignore` through, which doctor rejects later or not at all (lint-2.25, P3).
what: Every weakening of the stylelint preset is caught as the oxlint ones are, the 2.x theme guard leaves the v3 surface or speaks v3, and pre-edit denies what doctor rejects.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/check-theme*, packages/basalt-ui/src/guard/** and their exports, help and docs, only to remove them or point them at the v3 manifest
apps/playground/src/recipes/file-drop.tsx and timeline.tsx (their 2.x theme-allow lines only)
change: `basalt-ui lint` runs stylelint with an ignore path it manages (as it passes none to oxlint), or the weakened-config check reports a `.stylelintignore` that covers a file under a declared root; the seeded check gains a stylesheet offender so a dropped stylelint config is caught the way W1 is for oxlint. For check-theme: `rg` what in v3 still imports `src/guard/**` (the guard-hook verb, `vx-names`, `series-file`); if nothing v3 needs it, delete the verb, the module, its exports, the repo's `check-theme` script and step, and the playground's two 2.x `theme-allow` lines, with a MIGRATING row; otherwise keep the verb on the v3 manifest and preset and drop its 2.x hint and its `raw-hex` false alarm. pre-edit denies the shapes the weakened-config check reports (ignorePatterns over a root, a file-level disable naming every rule, a `.stylelintignore` over a root).
commits: fix: commits in packages/basalt-ui; a non-package commit for package.json and the playground waivers, in one PR.
proof: docs/v3/cycles/lint-2/fixtures/weaken.sh: W16 fails doctor; W15 and W17 still report; check-theme is gone from the gate (or the probe of lint-2.26 reports no 2.x hint and no raw-hex on '#657').
acceptance: A .stylelintignore over a subdirectory of a root fails doctor or is ignored by basalt-ui lint (test)
check-theme no longer ships, or it reads the v3 manifest and reports nothing on an Issue reference (test)
pre-edit denies ignorePatterns over a root and a blanket file disable (test)
out_of_scope: The rules' own misses and messages (v3-lint-2-lint); the waiver ceiling (v3-lint-2-waiver-ceiling).
